subject.title: chore: ignore .env variants while keeping .env.example templates

question: Should a repository administrator or `openclaw/openclaw-secops` authorize this exact `.gitignore` policy change after confirming all intended tracked environment templates use the preserved `.env.example` convention?
rationale: The patch changes the repository’s preventive boundary for accidental secret commits, and the repository’s own guard requires an explicit security-owner decision for the current head.

options.title: Authorize the reviewed rule
options.body: Approve the current head after confirming that `.env.*` should be ignored globally and `.env.example` is the supported tracked-template convention.

options.title: Decline and define a narrower policy
options.body: Do not authorize this head if the repository intentionally tracks a non-example `.env.*` file or needs a more selective ignore pattern.
